# East Coast Skiing

> > East Coast Skiing sells BootForge™ ski boot punch kits and ski accessories, featuring skier-driven tools designed in Connecticut by founder AJ.

The site specializes in DIY ski boot customization tools, particularly the BootForge™ line of boot punch kits for alpine and touring boots. Products also include FogArmor™ anti-fog spray, SnowToe™ ski hangers, GripSki Pro pole grips, and Basepaste™ base repair solutions.

## Key Topics

- BootForge™
- Ski boot punching and customization
- Boot fitting and bootfitting techniques
- East Coast skiing conditions
- DIY ski boot repair
- FogArmor™ anti-fog spray
- SnowToe™ ski storage
- GripSki Pro pole grips
- Basepaste™ base repair
- Alpine and touring boot modification
- Connecticut-based ski gear
- AJ (founder)
- Skier-driven product design

## BootForge™ Products

- [BootForge™ Ski Boot Punch Kit (Pro)](https://eastcoastskiing.com/products/Boot-Master-Ski-Boot-Punch-Tool): BootForge™ Pro Kit product page for alpine and touring boot customization
- [BootForge™ Standard Punch Kit](https://eastcoastskiing.com/products/boot-forge-standard-ski-boot-punch-kit): BootForge™ Standard Kit product page with Medium Punch Head and clamp
- [Build Your Own BootForge™ Kit](https://eastcoastskiing.com/products/boot-forge-build-your-own-ski-boot-punch-kit): Custom BootForge™ kit builder with punch heads and magnetic receiver
- [How to Punch Ski Boots (Pro Bootfitting Guide)](https://eastcoastskiing.com/guides/how-to-punch-ski-boots): Step-by-step guide for punching ski boots using BootForge™ kit by AJ
